imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- App icon in 192x192 resolution with transparent background suitable for all platforms (app-icon-192.dim_192x192.png)
- App icon in 512x512 resolution with transparent background for high-res displays (app-icon-512.dim_512x512.png)
- Maskable app icon in 512x512 resolution with safe zone padding for Android adaptive icons (app-icon-maskable.dim_512x512.png)
- iOS splash screen for iPhone portrait orientation showing app branding (splash-iphone.dim_750x1334.png)
- iOS splash screen for iPad portrait orientation showing app branding (splash-ipad.dim_1536x2048.png)

existing_features.title: Enhance PWA manifest to enable full app installation experience with complete metadata including name, short_name, description, start_url, display mode set to 'standalone', orientation preferences, and comprehensive icon set covering all required sizes (192x192, 512x512, maskable variants)

Upgrade service worker implementation to support full offline functionality with advanced caching strategies, background sync for data mutations when offline, and cache versioning for proper update management

Add iOS-specific meta tags and configurations for optimal installation experience on iOS devices including apple-mobile-web-app-capable, apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style, and apple-touch-startup-image for splash screens
Implement app-like navigation patterns with native-feeling transitions, gesture support for back navigation, and proper handling of hardware back button on Android devices
Add install prompt functionality that detects when the app is installable and presents a custom in-app installation banner with clear call-to-action for users to add the app to their device
Optimize app performance for mobile devices including lazy loading routes, image optimization, reducing bundle size, and implementing proper loading states for slow connections
Implement responsive design improvements to ensure the app feels native on all screen sizes from small phones to tablets, with touch-optimized tap targets (minimum 44x44px) and appropriate spacing
